artboards.title: B · One set at a time

annotations.text:
THE SYSTEM

Type - Archivo (display / UI), IBM Plex Mono (all numerals, micro-labels). Numeral slots are fixed-width and right-aligned, which is what actually makes the columns hold.

Ground - #09090B page, #131316 card, #101013 recessed figure surface, #1C1C21 raised, #16161A inset, #232328 / #18181C hairlines.

Text - #F4F4F2 primary, #C8C8CC body, #A0A0A8 secondary, #8E8E97 tertiary, #7E7E88 quaternary. The whole ramp was lifted one step after the first pass: the old tertiary sat at 4.5:1 and the step below it at 3.7:1 while carrying real numbers.

Value states - #8A8A93 planned, #F4F4F2 current, #C8C8CC logged. Dim, bright, settled.

Accent - #CCFF33 only for live, done, or the one primary action. Fill 0.11, border 0.28, glow 0.15. Chart bars use #7E9C28, the same hue held back, so the current week can be the only full-strength bar.

Radii - 8 inset, 12-15 cards and controls, pill for chips.

Targets - 44x44 minimum everywhere. The only things under it are inline text links (See all, Edit), which get padded hit areas that extend past their visual bounds.
This one is live — tick a set to see the row commit and the rest timer dock in. "Add set" works too. Rest length is a tweak above the frame.
Two other ways the logging screen could go, if the committed direction on page 1 isn't the one. Both are deliberately rough — they're here to pick an idea from, not a look.
